# Awesome Tech Blogs

> A community-curated list of 283 tech blogs by companies and individual developers, tagged by topic. Anyone can add their blog via a pull request on GitHub.

- Full list: https://tech-blogs.dev/list
- Add your blog: https://github.com/markodenic/awesome-tech-blogs
- Sitemap: https://tech-blogs.dev/sitemap.xml
